## Build it

- Compress a photo with NumPy's SVD at several ranks and plot quality against storage size.
- Check your hand-derived Jacobian of a small two-layer network against autograd in PyTorch.
- Write a notebook that computes entropy, cross-entropy, and KL divergence for two distributions and shows KL is not symmetric.
